Handmade Afghan ice cream in Kabul — sheer yakh, made with just milk, sugar, and cardamom, hand churned for over 2 hours by Mr. Ahmad Shah, who's been making it for 35 years. Topped with qaymak (thick clotted cream) and crushed almonds!
